review_notes: Reviewer requested changes (1 of 1 part(s)): Duplicate detection depends on object property insertion order. isDuplicateFact builds a JSON signature from fact.fields without sorting keys, so two semantically identical facts with different field key orderings will not match and slip past the duplicate check. Please normalize by sorting field keys before stringifying, and add a test that demonstrates duplicates are detected regardless of field key order.
handoff_instructions: Addressed review_notes: factSignature in packages/domain/src/fact-validation.ts now sorts fact.fields entries by key (instead of relying on Object.fromEntries + JSON.stringify's insertion-order-dependent key order) before stringifying, so isDuplicateFact matches semantically identical facts regardless of field insertion order. Added a test in packages/domain/test/fact-validation.test.ts ('flags duplicates regardless of the order fields were inserted in') that builds a fact with fields in reversed key order and asserts it is still detected as a duplicate. format:check, lint, typecheck and test all pass. No further changes planned; ready for re-review.
